milestone.title: Unified milestone lifecycle — single state machine replacing spec_status + execution_status + review_state

intent.outcome: Milestones carry ONE lifecycle field with 8 linear states (draft → groomed → approved → in-progress → done → self-reviewed → reviewed → complete) plus orthogonal overlays (blocked, deferred, needs_regrooming, cancelled). Today's three intersecting fields collapse into one. All existing milestones migrate in one bulk pass; gates G1–G14 are re-expressed against the single field. Foundational for the multi-lane path/status work.

problem.description: Today a milestone's position is split across spec_status (draft/interview/review/ready/implemented/verified), execution_status (planned/in-progress/done/blocked/deferred/cancelled), and review_state (pending-review/remediated/reviewed-clean). Three intersecting axes make state hard to reason about, hard to render as lanes, and cause confusion (blocked is BOTH an execution_status value AND has blocked_at/blocked_by fields). Grooming requires approval today; the desired flow is draft→groom with no approval, then approve. There is no self-reviewed rung. Every gate (G1–G14) and every command reads these three fields.

in_scope: Single `lifecycle` field replacing spec_status + execution_status + review_state; 8 states: draft, groomed, approved, in-progress, done, self-reviewed, reviewed, complete

Transitions: draft→groomed (no approval); groomed→approved (approval gate, runs AC/out-of-scope/approval checks); approved→in-progress; →done; →self-reviewed; →reviewed; →complete (terminal). Shortcut self-reviewed→complete on explicit human request
Overlays (NOT states): blocked {at,by,reason}, deferred {at,reason}, needs_regrooming:bool, cancelled (terminal exit). Remove `blocked` from lifecycle values — overlay-only
Bulk migration: done/verified→complete; implemented→done; ready→approved; interview/review→groomed; remediated→mapped to closest lifecycle state
Re-express gates G1–G14 against the single lifecycle field (each gate mapped to a transition; none orphaned or weakened)
Schema: drop spec_status/execution_status/review_state; add lifecycle + overlay fields
All commands (show, list, status, path, set-status, approve, reviews) read/write the new field
AGENT-READINESS.md, SPEC.md, gate docs updated to the new state machine
out_of_scope: The `remediation` state and findings-driven review automation (M101)
Backward-compatibility shims (one-shot migration; no dual-write period)

design_decisions.choice: Collapse 3 fields into 1 linear lifecycle; model blocked/deferred/needs_regrooming as orthogonal overlays, not states
design_decisions.rationale: A milestone can be in-progress AND blocked, or approved AND blocked — forcing one value conflates lifecycle stage with derivable status. Overlays compose with any state; the lifecycle stays a clean linear spine.

design_decisions.choice: Grooming no longer requires approval: draft→groomed is free; approval is the groomed→approved gate
design_decisions.rationale: Grooming is spec-shaping work; gating it behind approval blocked iteration. Approval is the commitment to build, which is the right place for the gate.

findings.description: External review 2026-07-05 ER-7: effective_lifecycle max() collapses verified + in-progress → complete (semantically wrong). mp-model milestone.rs:155-189, test pin :798-806. findings.description: External review 2026-07-05 ER-1 (CRITICAL — flagged critical in the review; mp schema caps at 'high'): transition functions do not write the lifecycle field. Only apply_spec_status writes it. complete_milestone (milestone.rs:1448), set_execution_status (:729), block_milestone (:1394), unblock_milestone (:1409), defer_milestone (:1422), reopen_milestone (:1437) all write legacy spec_status/execution_status and leave lifecycle (and overlay flags) stale. M100 itself reads lifecycle='in-progress' on disk while fully complete — disproves the 'single state machine' headline claim. Blast radius: any milestone transitioned after the bulk migration carries stale lifecycle; path_engine lane bucketing, reviews lifecycle_rollup, raul views all read stale values. This same bug also blocks mp milestone reopen/set-status on migrated milestones (see mp-dogfood-log 2026-07-05 entry). Fix: add sync_lifecycle_from_legacy helper (inverse of effective_lifecycle) called at the tail of every transition, OR set lifecycle+overlays explicitly in each (mirroring apply_spec_status at :538). At minimum complete_milestone must set lifecycle='complete' and block_milestone must set blocked=true. Pin with regression tests asserting post-transition lifecycle for each.
